pa-adaptation-notes.txt:
PA policy coding from bill summaries: choose the substantive issue named in the summary; a codebook heading, statute title, agency name, or incidental funding mechanism alone need not determine the code. Use the most specific applicable policy code. Purchased examples and codebook distinctions:
- Public School Code amendment on written agreements between districts -> 602, elementary/secondary education. Code 602 covers school district and board operations, general school funding, and governance.
- Title 42 Judiciary and Judicial Procedure amendment authorizing freezing defendants' assets in certain cases -> 1204, court administration/procedure. Court processes and legal mechanisms can be 1204 even in criminal matters.
- Host municipality agreements and moratorium for municipal and residual waste facilities -> 703, nonhazardous waste disposal. The host municipality angle does not shift this to local government; 704 is for hazardous waste/toxic chemicals.
- Title 18 Crimes and Offenses amendment defining racketeering activity -> 1202, white collar/organized crime. Racketeering is explicit in 1202; a Title 18 citation alone does not imply generic criminal code.
- Appropriations from professional licensure accounts to the Department of State for professional and occupational licensing boards -> 1527, regulation of services/occupational licensing. The funded activity controls over the appropriation form or Department of State name.
- Unemployment Compensation Law amendment changing compensation rate and amount -> 503, employee benefits, including public unemployment insurance; 103 concerns unemployment as a macroeconomic rate/statistic.
- Title 62 Procurement amendment concerning Department of General Services powers and duties within procurement organization -> 2008, government property/procurement operations.
- Insurance Committee investigation of monitoring hospital and medical costs -> 322, health care facilities/payments; the committee name alone does not make it insurance regulation.
- Standards for carbon monoxide alarms in schools -> 708, indoor environmental hazards. School location and penalties are incidental. Code 708 also covers indoor air quality, radon, lead, and asbestos.
- Joint payment for health care service contractors -> 323, provider and insurer payment/regulation. Distinguish 322 for facility construction, regulation, and payments, and 302 for health insurance access and broad coverage reform.
- County assessment law refunds for assessment errors and appeals -> 2404, local taxation and property tax administration.
- Public Welfare Code services relating to AIDS -> 331, prevention/communicable disease/public health. The statute title does not force social welfare.
- Administrative Code amendment, Commonwealth agency fees, further providing for Department of State -> 2011, government agency fees/administrative operations. Distinguish substantive occupational licensure under 1527.
- Unified retirement system for Commonwealth and political subdivision employees -> 2004, public employee benefits. Distinguish 503 for non-state employee benefits and unemployment compensation.
- Resolution designating Emergency Service Providers Week -> 1209, police, fire, and first responders. Ceremonial recognition follows the honored substantive group.
- Urban Growth Authority with grants, bonds, referendum, and appropriations -> 1403, urban economic development. Financing and authority machinery are secondary to urban growth purpose.
Related distinctions: 1203 covers illegal drug trafficking and drug-related property seizure; 1204 covers judicial administration, court procedures, and legal services; 602 is general elementary/secondary education, whereas 603 is disadvantaged students, 606 special education, and 607 standards/testing or subject excellence. These are codebook distinctions, not additional gold examples.
pa-adaptation-notes-2.txt: Additional PA bill-summary coding rules from 48 purchased examples (retain existing pa-adaptation-notes.txt): Code the substantive policy rather than the cited statute, administering agency, committee, funding form, ceremonial format, or incidental provision. Public School Code: district tuition, distressed district finances/boards, and proposed sign-language courses in public high schools -> 602; a Science and Applied-Knowledge Program -> 607. Higher education recognition (Penn State fencing championship) -> 601. Unusually, Insurance Department Act exemptions from continuing education requirements -> 601 (gold), despite the insurance statute. Liquor Code club license transfers, breweries/limited wineries, and enforcement -> 1528. Managed-care enrollee access to urgent care -> 302; broad Medicaid/medical-assistance eligibility, benefit, and payment package -> 301. Public Health Dentist position in Health Department -> 336; drug treatment/rehabilitation for drug offenders and Department of Drug and Alcohol Programs powers -> 342. Dog Law covering licensing, kennels, dog protection, and damages to livestock -> 405. Choking-emergency placard and duties in public eating/drinking places -> 1525. General Tax Reform Code rules on tax credit limits, additions to tax, combined income taxes, and sales/use rate -> 107; inheritance-tax spousal transfer exemption -> 1212. Capital budget and general-appropriation-bill procedure -> 105. Public-employee labor relations, fair-share fees, disability benefits, and state or local employee pensions (including military service credit) -> 2004. Municipal solid-waste incineration/recycling and host-municipality benefit fees -> 703, even with Department of Health or local-government provisions. State park maintenance with an incidental road designation -> 2101. Election officers -> 2012; unicameral General Assembly structure -> 2011. County Code ordinance fines/penalties -> 2401. Juror compensation -> 1204; county-jail prisoner release before minimum term -> 1205; harassment/stalking offenses -> 1210. Vehicle police removal and traffic-citation form contents -> 1006; school-zone speed limits -> 1002 (school location incidental). Study of regulation of passenger common carriers, taxicab medallions and fund -> 1098. Alternative regulation of telecommunications services -> 1706. Right-to-Know public-record exceptions -> 208. Unattended children's safety in public places -> 332. Resolution honoring Welsh heritage -> 201. Veterans' benefit preservation and creation of Veterans' Affairs department -> 1609. Foreign steel import quotas -> 1807. Private safe-deposit-box companies regulated by Banking Department -> 1501. Resolution subjects follow the substantive topic rather than the resolution form.
